clauses.treatment_must_reach_note: treatment seed-mean R_own <= 0.5 x twin seed-mean R_own; on these control rows twin R_own = 0.1036, so treatment R_own <= 0.0518. The probe reruns the twin in the same code path; the ratio uses the rerun twin. PC value = PC R_own / twin R_own; twin value = twin R_own / twin-replicate-B R_own

cheat_detail.definition: (a) the ruler reads success on CHEAT rows (sensitivity) AND (b) the audit, which recomputes R_own, R_other, D from each row's stored genomes and the seed's palette, flags every CHEAT row, with zero flags on POSITIVE_CONTROL, NULL_TWIN and NULL_TWIN_B rows

revisions.what: initial spec and controls, run once
revisions.result: all clauses attainable and discriminating, cheat detected; no revision needed
